machine: AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D, 8 physical cores / 16 logical CPUs, WSL2
description: Entity-history opt-out and grouped-update decode allocation cleanup against the preceding dirty rc.128 candidate; identical harnesses in both sources.
limitations: Fresh sequential Node processes pinned to logical CPU 2, including runtime helper threads. Other development services were running.
Decode cases use official nengi-buffers and alternating pre-encoded packets; no transport, physics, renderer or game checkpoint reconstruction.
Apply cases exclude synthetic snapshot construction and binary decoding. Heap readings are occupancy/retention, not allocated bytes.
GC observations are runtime event counts/durations in the decode loop, not complete game pauses; one large history-off run has a slower tail.
No full Loam benchmark was run. Public performance numbers identify source hashes, not just the candidate version.
